item.title: Week 10: Commanders at Giants
item.description: Thu 11/12 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: NYG -1.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model NYG 67% vs. market 53% | On paper the Giants have the edge (The Giants rank 10th in red-zone TD rate, 60%), while Washington's best counter is to tackle in space (Washington's defense ranks 3rd in YAC over expected per catch, -0.5 yds allowed). Under center, Jayden Daniels ranks 19th of 31 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Malik Nabers gets 31% of the Giants' targets and 35% of its air yards, and Washington's pass defense ranks 16th. The model favors the Giants at 67%, mostly on home field (1.7 pts) and passing matchup (1.6 pts).
